tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Quotes the live x402 agent rail ($0.05 USDC on Base) and lists free verification tools. Stripe catalogue SKUs are not listed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: x402 seal verify. Arguments that cannot be a seal UUID are HTTP 400 before payment. Empty arguments are unpaid HTTP 402. Paid calls are answered from the seal registry at $0.05 USDC on Base. For free verification use verify_record.

tools.name: query_provenance
tools.description: Free public lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token. Reads matching rows from the canonical auth_seals registry when public Supabase configuration is available, and also resolves published packs. A registry match means registered only; it does not verify a signature or prove a physical item is genui

tools.description: Free. Fetch the exact published AuthiChain v0.1 JWS from the signed-record registry and pass it to the canonical edge-router verifier. tools.name: dpp_readiness_check
tools.description: Free EU Digital Product Passport readiness check. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

tools.name: scan_living_qr
tools.description: Free. Scan a stored Living QR. GET https://authichain.com/qron/r/{object_id} returns AuthiChain Verification Decision v1. This host verifies the signature. A missing id is presentation_not_found. Not an x402 payment endpoint, and it does not inspect a physical product.
